note: Burkina Faso: nationals of the ECOWAS states, Mali, Niger and the UAE enter without a visa, those of the Central African Republic, Mauritania and Morocco for 90 days, Singapore's for 30, Hong Kong's for 14 (by Hong Kong's Immigration Department); US nationals are refused (taken as a visa); everyone else needs a visa from a mission or online (taken as an e-Visa). Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Embassy in Washington, which confirmed the e-Visa (since 1 February 2023, short stays up to 3 months); it still describes visas for US passports and may predate their suspension, and names no exemptions, which stand on Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Burkina Faso
sources.said: Visitors to Burkina Faso must obtain a visa from one of the Burkina Faso diplomatic missions or online, unless they come from one of the visa exempt countries or a country whose citizens may obtain a visa on arrival. ... Citizens of the following 19 countries can visit Burkina Faso without a visa: All ECOWAS member states Central African Republic (90 days) Hong Kong Mali Mauritania (90 days) Morocco (90 days) Niger Singapore (30 days) United Arab Emirates ... According to the Hong Kong Immigration Department, citizens of Hong Kong can enter Burkina Faso without a visa for 14 days. ... refused to United States nationals

sources.title: Ambassade du Burkina Faso à Washington: Activités consulaires, Visa
sources.said: Visa Depuis le 1er février 2023, la délivrance des visas d'entrée au Burkina Faso dénommé “evisaburkina” se fait en ligne. Les dossiers sont donc soumis en ligne sur le site www.visaburkina.bf ... Les demandeurs du visa de court séjour (03 mois maximum) recevront un récépissé ou un accusé de réception avant le voyage. ... La durée de la validité du visa sur les passeports de nationalité américaine reste cinq (05) ans et la vignette sera apposée sur le passeport à l'arrivée à Ouagadougou. CONDITIONS D'ETABLISSEMENT DE VISA ... Un money order de 140 dollars US
